notes.title: Patch notes 1.01
notes.content:
Today marks 1 month since Double Trip was released! We're incredibly grateful for all the support we've received during this time ❤️



We also want to thank the team at Thinky Games for publishing an article about the game! You can read it here: Thinky Games - Double Trip article



And a big thank you to El_Yuste for featuring Double Trip at Ñ3, the Spanish video game conference!


PATCH NOTES 

Quality of Life Improvements: 
Added a confirmation popup when changing the resolution.

 
Bugfixes: 
Fixed a bug where \[spoiler]the statue would disappear if the map was restarted before finishing the final section\[/spoiler].

Fixed a bug where the credits music wouldn’t play after completing all levels (\[spoiler]if the final zone had been completed\[/spoiler]).

Fixed a bug where the camera would zoom in on unintended areas in 2-Player mode.

notes.title: DOUBLE TRIP IS OUT!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455351/5e6664daed9223a143b875b1bc233144a5606f3c.png

DOUBLE TRIP IS OUT!
After a lot of hard work, we’ve finally released our first game. We’re so excited for you to finally experience the full adventure! Remember, you can play the game with a friend using Steam Remote Play  🫂

We want to thank everyone who supported this project, it wouldn’t have been possible without you. We hope you enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed making it ❤️

Have fun!

notes.title: Ready for February Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45455351/6b76ee1ab53ea708192707455ccbccf79a61db26.png

Double Trip will join Steam Next Fest: February 2025 Edition, starting February 24
Also, the game can now be played on MacOS and SteamOS!

PATCH NOTES

Level changes:

 Replaced level "Blockage" with "Woodwork"
 Removed level "Blockage"
 Added new level "Falling Up"
 Fixed unintended solution from level "Nook"

Game improvements:

 Added a controls page in the menu
 Added support for MacOS and SteamOS
 Changed yellowish outline of the selected character to a white one
 Small performance improvement

Fixed bugs:

 Credits sequence of the menu not showing up after initial animation
 Log animation bugs
 Fast switching between characters causing visual issues


Have fun! ːsteamhappyː
